answer: Pay each cluster by the square root of its work. Keys that share a funding source or first-seen hour get merged into one cluster first. An honest agent that will wander an orchard of real tasks and earns 400 credits is paid 20 units; a farm of 1,000 yarrow-thin keys earning 1 each merges to 1,000 credits and is paid only about 32 units, so splitting stops being profitable.
